description: Polymer web component behavior for multi-selectable elements, defining properties, methods, and behaviors for managing multiple selections in a Polymer-based UI component.

classes.name: Polymer.IronMultiSelectableBehaviorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of multi-selectable behavior, managing selection state, toggling, and updates.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects a value; toggles if multi is true, otherwise sets as selected.

methods.name: multiChanged
methods.description: Observer for changes to the 'multi' property, updates selection behavior accordingly.

methods.name: _updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the selection state based on current properties.

methods.name: _selectMulti
methods.description: Selects multiple values, updating internal selection state.

methods.name: _selectionChange
methods.description: Handles changes in selection, updating selected items.

methods.name: _toggleSelected
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a given value.
